{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display the first few rows to understand the data
print(df.head())

# Check for missing values in the 'body_mass_g' column
print('\nMissing values in body_mass_g:')
print(df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Compute the mean body mass, ignoring missing values
mean_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f'\nMean body mass (ignoring missing values): {mean_body_mass}')"}
